AP News, 21 Jul 2026 — ASEAN foreign ministers opened 3 days of talks in Manila; joint statement called for immediate halt to Middle East fighting and full/safe reopening of Strait of Hormuz. "We expressed serious concern over the rapidly evolving situation in the Middle East, particularly the renewed hostilities involving the United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran." Backdrop: South China Sea clash — Philippine marine suffered head injury after being struck with baton by China Coast Guard at Second Thomas Shoal (Diplomat/Reuters). Rubio arrived Manila; meets ASEAN counterparts + Chinese FM Wang Yi on Wednesday (sidelines). Philippine FM Ma. Theresa Lazaro: "There is serious concern on the developments in the Middle East. If you notice, this is the only document that involves geopolitics in our discussions." Myanmar crisis also on agenda.
